segments.oily: One reviewer with mostly oily skin reports the cream works well and is not greasy.
segments.dry: Several reviewers with dry skin, including one with dry, thin under-eye skin, describe the cream as hydrating and effective at brightening without irritation.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports the cream feels lightweight and leaves the under-eye area brighter and more refreshed.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their eye area or skin as sensitive report no irritation, tingling, or burning, with one noting improvement in dark circles, fine lines, and moisture together.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin reports the cream works well for covering under-eyes but caused milia after repeated use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s report brightening and a more awake look, with one crediting the cream with reduced fine lines and one calling it excellent for mature skin.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report reduced fine lines and wrinkles around the eyes with continued use; one long-term user in her 50s reports no wrinkles at all, while another says results are not yet confirmed after only a few weeks.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the cream as hydrating, moisturizing dry or thin under-eye skin without greasiness; one reviewer instead reports it dries out with a white residue that does not absorb.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports no irritation even when applied above the eye.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer notes the cream did not sting or irritate the skin, suggesting good tolerance for compromised skin.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports that small dry spots under the eyes stopped appearing after starting the product; no other reviewers discuss this concern.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the cream caused milia under the eyes after a few uses, while another anticipates the same risk but had not yet observed it; a third reviewer with normal skin confirms milia developed after repeated use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports the cream is not greasy; several others across skin types also describe it as non-greasy or lightweight.

I had to switch to an eye cream because of dry eye, and this is the best I found it. It's moisturizing and it seems to be softening and taking away some fine lines around my eyes couple more weeks of using it should tell the whole story. I highly recommend it for (dry) eye cream.

This is my favorite eye cream. It's tinted which I love and it goes on very smooth. It really brightens my eyes and blends well with my tinted moisturizer. I'm 52 and don't wear foundation every day and I love how well it brightens my eye area and makes me look more awake. I have mostly oily skin and this cream works well on my skin. It's not greasy.

Gifted by origins I don't have very noticeable dark circles under my eyes. They are more like sunken under eyes and my skin around the eye it's very dry and using this eye cream provides moisture to the thin area and looks more illuminated.

Gifted by origins GinZing Brightening Eye Cream with Vitamin C-Cool Shade effectively brightens and visibly reduces my dark circles. This formula hydrates and minimizes puffiness, and over time, it reduces the appearance of dark circles. In the picture, you can see that I gently patted the product on one eye with my ring finger under it. Then, I took a small amount and applied it above my eye. Surprisingly, there was no irritation, even though I have super sensitive skin. I'm actually loving this product because nothing else has helped me with my baggy, dark circles, but this one does.

extraits.titre: I use this product daily! Love it.
extraits.texte: This has become a staple in my daily routine for moisturizing and lightening the dark circles under my eyes. I absolutely love that it has a built-in color corrector, which saves me an extra step in the morning. It provides excellent hydration and coverage without settling into fine lines, making it a truly fantastic product for mature skin.
